ADMIN_CLASSES

Admin-login view classes. The ADMIN_* entries compose the admin BEM block; GOOGLE_AUTH_BTN/GOOGLE_ICON are standalone blocks (different block prefix) since Google's sign-in widget styling is applied to those nodes and must not inherit admin-* selectors.
